theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [Field α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [Archimedean α] (f : α →+*o α) : f = OrderRingHom.id α := by
  intro h
  apply_fun (OrderRingHom.toRingHom) at h
  apply_fun (OrderRingHom.toOrderPreserving) at h
  apply_fun (OrderRingHom.toAddMonoidHom) at h
  apply_fun (OrderRingHom.toMonoidHom) at h
  apply_fun (OrderRingHom.toGroupHom) at h
  apply_fun (OrderRingHom.toAddGroupHom) at h
  apply_fun (OrderRingHom.toAddCommGroupHom) at h
  apply_fun (OrderRingHom.toCommGroupHom) at h
  apply_fun (OrderRingHom.toCommRingHom) at h
  exact eq_of_order_preserving_ring_endomorphism_id f
